g1.label: 1. ___ free entry argue that culture belongs to everyone
g1.why: The paragraph gives the case for free entry, so it reports the people who support it.

g2.label: 2. ___ free entry encourages people to return
g2.why: A second argument from the same side, reported without naming who holds it; “also” adds it to the first.

g3.label: 3. ___, those who favour charging point out …
g3.why: The essay now turns to the opposite view, so it needs a contrast linker.

g4.correct: Critics of free entry also argue that
accept: Critics of free entry also argue that
g4.label: 4. ___ people value what they pay for
g4.why: This is still the other side’s argument; “In my opinion” would contradict the writer’s view in the introduction.

g5.label: 5. ___, although charging would raise money …
g5.why: The final paragraph sums up and gives the writer’s view, so it opens with a concluding phrase.

g6.label: 6. ___ entry should remain free for everyone
g6.why: The conclusion must give the writer’s own view; “Some people argue” only reports others again.

g1.label: 1. Report one side: ___ argue that it builds good study habits
g1.why: “Argue” needs a subject that names the group holding the view; “In my view” gives your own.

g2.label: 2. Report the other side: ___ point out that …
g2.why: “Critics point out” reports the opposing side; the other options give your own view and do not fit “point out”.

g3.label: 3. Report a common view: ___ that cities are lonelier …
g3.why: The passive “It is often claimed that” reports a view without saying who holds it.

g4.label: 4. Give your own view: ___, the advantages outweigh …
g4.why: “In my view” states your own opinion; “Many people argue” reports someone else’s.

g5.label: 5. Many people ___ that technology makes us less sociable
g5.why: “People” is plural, and “believe” is a state verb, so present simple: people believe.

g6.label: 6. ___ this argument to some extent
g6.why: We agree with an argument or a person (we agree to a plan or proposal); “I am agree” is wrong because “agree” is already a verb.

g7.label: 7. Some researchers ___ that short breaks …
g7.why: “Researchers” is plural: they suggest. “Suggest” is a cautious way to report a claim.

g8.label: 8. ___ that cars are convenient, I believe …
g8.why: “While it is true that …” accepts the other side’s point before your view; the other two are not correct English.

g1.correct: In conclusion, although charging would raise money, I believe free entry is better because museums exist to share knowledge.
accept: In conclusion, although charging would raise money, I believe free entry is better because museums exist to share knowledge.
g1.label: 1. Conclusion: free museums
g1.why: It sums up both sides and gives the writer’s opinion; the first option has no opinion and the last adds a new idea.

g2.correct: To sum up, while starting early has some benefits, I believe most children gain more from starting at seven, when they are ready to learn.
accept: To sum up, while starting early has some benefits, I believe most children gain more from starting at seven, when they are ready to learn.
g2.label: 2. Conclusion: school starting age
g2.why: Only this one gives an opinion; the others list advantages with no view or bring in a new topic.

g3.correct: To conclude, although offices help teamwork, in my view most employees work best with a mix of home and office days.
accept: To conclude, although offices help teamwork, in my view most employees work best with a mix of home and office days.
g3.label: 3. Conclusion: home or office
g3.why: It states the writer’s view; “both have advantages and disadvantages” gives no answer, and internet costs are a new idea.

g4.correct: In conclusion, I believe a small tourist tax is fair, as long as the money is spent on the places that visitors use.
accept: In conclusion, I believe a small tourist tax is fair, as long as the money is spent on the places that visitors use.
g4.label: 4. Conclusion: tourist tax
g4.why: It answers the question with the writer’s view; the others add a new idea or only say people disagree.

g5.label: 5. Review (Opinion Essay): ___ the rain, the match went ahead
g5.why: “Despite” takes a noun (the rain); “although” needs a full clause — from the Opinion Essay exercise.

g6.label: 6. Review (Opinion Essay): ___, more people began cycling
g6.why: Cycling more is a consequence of higher fuel prices, so a result linker — from the Opinion Essay exercise.
